BETA Close X Currys Plc has announced the purchase of 2,303,689 of its own ordinary shares for cancellation between July 2, 2026, and July 6, 2026, at prices ranging from 155.20p to 163.00p per share. Following these transactions, the company will have 1,094,669,690 ordinary shares in issue, with no shares held in treasury. This updated total represents the company's total voting rights.
